headline: Saudi Arabia 2025: wages are not 'activity' under the Income Tax Law; Saudi employees pay 9 % annuities up to SAR 45,000 a month; the SANED rate is delegated to a decision not published with the law.
registry_correction: PIT N verified (Income Tax Law art. 1-2). Contributions: SIL 1421 H art. 18(2)(a) 9 % up to SAR 45,000 a month (art. 19) for Saudis; SANED share per CEDA decision (0.25 %-1 %). Zakat: not on wages (law not read).
